verdict.rationale: Vanta's API docs explicitly describe bulk operations — bulk assigning owners, marking resources out of scope, and offloading employees in batches — plus programmatic listing/filtering of tests, documents, and policies across a tenant, which AI agents can drive via the API or MCP server. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of bulk operation limits or performance at scale, and no evidence of batch write endpoints beyond the few named examples.
